existing_finding_connections.trace: Current PresentedSkeleton retains quickstep_phase as Option<UnitInterval> without an action start or direction; its separate attack phase carries start, animation, hand and continuation identity. When both previous presented and new authoritative states are quicksteps, advance_presented_quickstep reuses the retained phase and advances a clone of the new source from its start tick without comparing action instance. A symbolic phase 0.75 from action A can therefore be applied to distinct action B if the client observes B while A remains presented.
existing_finding_connections.authoritative_admission: The current server input path invokes begin_authoritative_quickstep for a guarded upright grounded actor and valid direction. SkeletonState::begin_dodge rejects a second dodge while the authoritative action is still Dodge. ActionTimeline::sample and advance_action keep the end-tick sample at phase one and return to idle after the end tick, so a later new dodge is not ruled out by that action-busy guard once the first has completed. Further input gates and timing must still be established for any actual sequence.
existing_finding_connections.guards_and_limits: The visual tail deliberately smooths coalesced observations; when the authoritative state is not quickstep and no visual quickstep continues, or cached phase is one, the relevant clear guards operate. A just-entering action with no retained phase starts from the new source. The conditional example requires a valid later action, retained previous presentation and observation/coalescing timing that does not deliver a clearing idle state first. No server/client, input, packets, runtime timing, visual output or gameplay effects observed. Tactical state remains authoritative.
existing_finding_connections.connected_repair: Bind retained visual quickstep progress to the existing authoritative action identity (start tick and relevant action payload), reinitialize for a distinct instance, and preserve same-instance smoothing, permitted tail behavior and authoritative combat state. Trace all interrupt, direction and network timing policies before implementation.
existing_finding_connections.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and validation authorization, cover same-action coalescence and tail, a new action while an old visual phase is retained, a phase-one handoff, alternate directions and action-interrupt precedence.
